chatLab.title: Chat
chatLab.subtitle: Talks to your OpenClaw gateway default agent (tools and skills follow the gateway host). Streams replies and reasoning when the gateway streams them. Conversations are saved locally in History in the sidebar.
chatLab.heroSubtitle: Hi there! Ready to help anytime
chatLab.heroInputPlaceholder: Describe a task or ask anything. Type / to pick a skill
chatLab.toolbarSkillHint: Pick a skill for this message; a short skill hint is prefixed when sending. Type / in the box to search.
chatLab.systemPrompt: You are a capable, friendly assistant. Think briefly when helpful, then answer clearly in the user's language.
chatLab.wechatSystemPrompt: WeChat channel — token cost matters. When the user wants a file/screenshot/PDF: copy/move it into the workspace only (cp/mv). NEVER read_file/cat/Get-Content the whole document. NEVER paste file bodies in replies. Open Studio sends the attachment automatically. Reply in at most two short sentences.
chatLab.emptyHint: Type a message below to start.
chatLab.placeholder: Message… press Enter to send. Type / for skills…
chatLab.rotateSessionKeyHint: Assign a new sessionKey to reduce queue/lock contention with the previous conversation. After enabling lean plugins, fully restart the OpenClaw gateway or it keeps the old plugin set in memory.
chatLab.electronOnly: Streaming chat requires the Open Studio desktop app (Electron preload IPC). Pure browser preview cannot reach the model securely.
chatLab.thinkingHint: Some gateways/models stream reasoning deltas (e.g. reasoning_content)
chatLab.emptyAssistantReply: The assistant finished without visible reply text (it may only have streamed reasoning, or the gateway completed without text deltas).
chatLab.streamAbortedBeforeReply: The reply stream was aborted before the gateway responded (often a multi-agent fan-out race — retry or mention fewer agents at once).
chatLab.streamEmptyBeforeGatewayReply: The gateway returned no content (session prep or connection issue — restart the app and try again).
chatLab.gatewayUrlMissing: Set an OpenClaw gateway URL under Settings → Model.
chatLab.gatewayAuthFailed: Gateway rejected the request (401). Check the gateway token or server authentication.
chatLab.gatewayHttp404: The gateway returned HTTP 404 for the chat API. Wait until the gateway log shows it is ready, make sure the URL is the main gateway base (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18789 with no extra path), set a gateway token if required, and update OpenClaw if your version is older.
chatLab.gatewayMissingOperatorScope: The gateway did not grant operator read/write scopes on this connection. If the gateway runs on the same PC as Open Studio, set Gateway Base URL to http://127.0.0.1:<port> (avoid LAN IPs or custom hostnames). Restart the dev gateway / Electron after changing it. Remote gateways require OpenClaw device pairing.
chatLab.gatewayUnreachableDetail: Cannot reach the gateway ({{detail}}). Start it on this machine (for example: openclaw gateway) and confirm the URL under Settings → Model.
chatLab.gatewayRetryHint: This page will keep retrying every few seconds. If it never connects, start the gateway or check the URL under Settings → Model.
chatLab.previewOfficeNeedsPublicUrl: Office previews (Excel / PowerPoint) need a public HTTPS URL for the file so Microsoft Office Online can embed it. For local files, download and open them on your device.
chatLab.previewWorkspaceNeedsApp: Workspace file preview requires the Open Studio desktop app.
chatLab.previewErrOutsideOpenClawState: That file path is outside the OpenClaw agent workspace (e.g. ~/.openclaw-dev/agents/<id>/workspace). The dock can only open files under that folder. If the model saved HTML to your repo or elsewhere, save it under the agent workspace instead, or use the code-block Preview action to render inline HTML from the message.
chatLab.previewOfficeLocalBinary: Local Excel / PowerPoint files cannot be embedded in the side panel. Use a public HTTPS link or open the file on your device.
chatLab.previewIpcMissing: The desktop app is running an older main process without the preview API. Fully quit Open Studio (all windows) and start it again — reloading the page is not enough.
chatLab.artifactsSelectFile: Select a file on the left to preview
chatLab.composerDismissEditHint: Dismiss — send will append a new message instead of rewriting from here
chatLab.composerResizeHandleAria: Drag up or down to resize the input area
chatLab.composerExitLongEditHint: Collapse the input; Enter sends again (Shift+Enter for newline)
chatLab.imageTooLarge: Each image must be under 2 MB
chatLab.invalidImageType: Only image files can be attached
chatLab.maxComposerFileRefs: Maximum {{max}} path references in the composer
chatLab.fileRefPathUnavailable: Could not resolve a local path for the dropped item
chatLab.fileRefElectronOnly: Local path references are only available in the desktop app
chatLab.messageImagesCopyNote: ({{count}} images attached — image data not copied)
chatLab.wechatNeedScan: Click "Scan QR" to get a bind code
chatLab.wechatNeedRestartMain: Main process is outdated and WeChat IPC is missing. Fully quit and restart Open Studio.

userConfig.addProfileHint: Click OK when finished to save.
userConfig.sessionKeyHint: Must match an agent id in openclaw.json (default dev → agent:dev:…). If logs show sessions.json locks for tens of seconds, try a new key and move ~/.openclaw-dev to a local SSD; exclude the folder from aggressive real-time AV if you can.
userConfig.chatLabLeanPlugins: Chat: lean gateway plugins (LLM-only, faster startup)
userConfig.chatLabLeanPluginsHint: When enabled, Studio syncs only your active LLM provider plugin into the dev state dir (~/.openclaw-dev / port 19001) and omits heavy plugins (browser, phone control, etc.). **After Save, fully quit and restart the OpenClaw gateway** — otherwise the process keeps the old plugin list in memory and stays slow. Turn off and save if you need the full tool surface, then restart the gateway.
userConfig.gatewayAdvancedHint: Open Studio streams to this gateway using model openclaw/default so the configured agent can use tools and skills. Start the gateway on the host (e.g. openclaw gateway) and set a token if your server requires it.
